# Santos Auto Detailing

> Premium mobile auto detailing, ceramic coating, and paint correction serving Kelowna and the Okanagan, BC.

Santos Auto Detailing is a Kelowna-based mobile and in-shop detailer offering interior and exterior detailing, ceramic coating, paint correction, fleet, boat, and aircraft detailing. Booking, deposits, and a monthly maintenance subscription are handled online.

## Services

- [Interior Detailing](/interior-detailing-kelowna): Deep cabin reset and shampoo.
- [Exterior Detailing](/exterior-detailing-kelowna): Hand wash, decontamination, and sealant.
- [Ceramic Coating](/ceramic-coating-kelowna): Multi-year SiO2 paint protection.
- [Paint Correction](/paint-correction-kelowna): Machine polishing to remove swirls and defects.
- [Fleet Detailing](/fleet-detailing-kelowna): Recurring detailing for business vehicles.
- [Boat Detailing](/boat-detailing-kelowna): Marine detailing on Okanagan Lake.
- [Aircraft Detailing](/aircraft-detailing-kelowna): Private aviation detailing.

## Locations

- [Kelowna](/auto-detailing-kelowna): Mobile and in-shop service in Kelowna and the Central Okanagan.

## Booking

- [Book Now](/book): Choose a package and schedule.
- [Custom Quote](/book/quote): Send photos for a tailored quote.
- [Maintenance Plan](/maintenance): Monthly subscription with included visits.
